test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 64

questions.question: A scheme like ‘Buy 19, Get 1 Free’ on the same kind of articles with the same marked price attracts _____% discount.
Find the smallest natural number that must be subtracted from 2433 so that the remainder is a perfect square.
What will be the total surface area of a right circular cone whose perpendicular height is 6 cm and slant height is 10 cm? [Use π = 3.14]

A man spends 46% of his monthly salary on house rent. Additionally, he spends ₹544 on conveyance and ₹5,441 on groceries. If he is left with a savings of ₹846 at the end of the month, what is his monthly salary (in ₹)?
Two pipes, P and Q, can together fill a cistern in 4 hours. If pipe P alone can fill the cistern in 20 hours, then how long (in hours) would pipe Q alone take to fill the cistern?
The simple interest on a certain principal amount is ₹866 for a period of 4 years at a rate of 2% per annum. What is the principal sum (in ₹)?
A scheme like ‘Buy 17, Get 3 Free’ on the same kind of articles with the same marked price attracts a discount of _____%.
A man receives ₹8,936 per month as salary. He saves 50% of his salary every month. His expenditure (in ₹) per month is:
A train goes from A to B at a speed of 10 km/hr and returns from B to A by the same route at 15 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr) of the train during the two-way journey is:

A product mix includes three products with the following selling prices and quantities: Product A - $10 (40 units), Product B - $15 (30 units), and Product C - $20 (20 units). What is the weighted average selling price of the product mix? (Round your answer to two decimal places.)
What is the smallest number exactly divisible by each one of the numbers 12, 15, 20 and 27?
The value of x in the proportion equation 43 : 86 :: 32 : x is:
A man buys a second-hand car for ₹1,01,000 and spends ₹50,000 on its repairs. What should be its selling price if he wants to earn a 19% profit?
What is the average of all the natural numbers from 1 to 99?
The number 848829305 is divisible by which of the following?

Pipe A can fill a tank in 6 hours, pipe B can fill the same tank in 10 hours and pipe C can fill the same tank in 15 hours. The time taken (in hours) by them to fill the same tank if they operate together is:

A started a business with a capital of ₹4,62,000. After 4 months, B joined him with a certain amount of capital. At the end of a year of A's starting the business, the profit was shared in the ratio 5 : 2. How much (in ₹) did B invest?
A man receives ₹5,842 per month as salary. He saves 50% of his salary every month. His expenditure (in ₹) per month is:
The average of three numbers is 20. If two numbers are 15 and 25, the third number is:
Three partners, Mohit, Parul and Charu, invest ₹480, ₹540, and ₹690 respectively in a business. If they divide a profit of ₹1311, find the share of profit received by Mohit.
